missing_capability: organization egress policy denies all container-registry blob CDNs (403 on CONNECT); base images cannot be pulled and base digests cannot be resolved/pinned
policy_note: proxy README: 403/407 policy denials must be reported, not retried or bypassed; no FROM-scratch substitute image was fabricated

gate_identifier_reconciliation.note: Reconciled to the canonical identifier set in CONTAINER_GATE_DEFINITION.json on 2026-08-29. C16-image and C17-image were deprecated, noncanonical aliases of C16 and C17 by owner decision (rasaha) and are not distinct additional gates.
gate_identifier_reconciliation.change: C16-image -> C16, C17-image -> C17; no gate added or removed

gate_execution_state_unchanged: every P3E-CTR gate and every historical gate remains NOT_EXECUTED; no evidence obligation is marked complete

distinguished_conditions.note: Six separate conditions were previously conflated as one 'egress' story. They are distinguished here; each stands or falls on its own.

1_sandbox_egress_limitation.scope: the agent sandbox in which the P3E work was performed - NOT GitHub Actions
1_sandbox_egress_limitation.condition: the organization egress proxy denies container-registry blob CDNs (403 on CONNECT to production.cloudfront.docker.com and pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com)
1_sandbox_egress_limitation.effect: no container gate can be executed from the sandbox; this is why the P3E pass reported the gates NOT_EXECUTED

2_malformed_trivy_action_reference.condition: the workflow pinned aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0 while the upstream tag is v0.28.0, so action resolution failed before any step ran
2_malformed_trivy_action_reference.scope_limit: confirms only that the action resolves and the job starts; the run never reached the scan step, so Trivy's executable and vulnerability databases remain UNTESTED from any environment

3_ci_registry_reachability.finding: GitHub Actions CI CAN reach the container registry
3_ci_registry_reachability.evidence: in https://github.com/rasaha/symbolu/actions/runs/33268204975 resolve_base_images resolved both images successfully; the step failed on a digest comparison, not on a 403
3_ci_registry_reachability.consequence: condition 1 must not be generalized to CI. Registry reachability is not what blocks the container gates in CI.

4_upstream_tag_drift.condition: the mutable tags now resolve to different index digests than the ratified pins
4_upstream_tag_drift.status: PRESENT - this is what fails base-image-digest-verification in CI today
4_upstream_tag_drift.interpretation: expected behaviour of a mutable tag; it says nothing about the images the ratified digests name

5_owner_decision_hold_ratified_digests.statement: tag movement does not authorize a re-pin; the ratified digests stay authoritative and are to be sourced from the approved internal mirror when provisioned
5_owner_decision_hold_ratified_digests.consequence: the container job stays red at base-image-digest-verification until the mirror serves the ratified digests. That halt is the ratified MUST_HALT_ON_DIGEST_MISMATCH control working, not a defect.
5_owner_decision_hold_ratified_digests.future_change: only via the controlled base-image refresh recorded in the ratification record

6_evidence_manifest_flaw.condition: the evidence-manifest step hashed files from a repository directory holding seven committed records, several stating result NOT_EXECUTED, so a run that scanned nothing reported non-null scan hashes
correction: runtime evidence is written to a fresh run-scoped directory under RUNNER_TEMP keyed by run id and attempt, outside the checkout, and asserted empty at creation
an artifact is hashed only when its producer step reported success in this run
a failed, skipped or absent producer yields a null hash, the producer status and INCOMPLETE, with no fallback to a pre-existing file
the manifest records commit, run id, run attempt and the producing step per entry
the seven committed records were moved to reference-evidence/ and labelled, not deleted
deployment/governance-studio/artifacts/ is git-ignored so run output cannot be committed
6_evidence_manifest_flaw.tests: deployment/governance-studio/tests/test_evidence_manifest.py - ten tests, including negatives for committed records, pre-populated directories, and failed and skipped producers
6_evidence_manifest_flaw.obligations_unaffected: no evidence obligation is marked complete by this correction
